changes.added: Repeated late corrections from clients wear me down near the filing deadline.
Last-minute requests to rush the team’s checks wear me out.
Chasing the same missing paperwork twice is the part that wears me down.
I enjoy making the bakery’s messy papers understandable, but chasing missing receipts after another client call wears me out.
Having to repeat a missing-paper request when the filing queue is growing wears me down.
Having to redo a file for the same missed code is the tiring part.
Reopening a file just before leaving to collect the children wears me out.
I like making a client’s figures balance, but repeating the same tax-code mistake is frustrating.
I enjoy finding the invoice that explains a mismatch, but rushed corrections near pickup time wear me down.
I enjoy showing a new starter why a receipt matters, but hurried files with missing papers wear me out.
I like tracing an entry back to a clear receipt, but being rushed through an unfamiliar code wears me down.
I enjoy seeing a bank entry finally match its invoice, but correcting the same tax code twice wears me out.
I like helping a small-business owner understand a figure, but late missing receipts make the end of the day tiring.
